mechanism_narrative: A low Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceed 140,000 thousand, it signals robust labor market conditions that increase consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 140000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST > 1000) and industrial production (INDPRO > 105) signal sustained economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to robust demand and supply coordination.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1000 and INDPRO > 105.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 230), persistently low Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) signals inadequate monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate rate hikes and inflation erosion of real returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS < 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Positive GDP growth (GDPC1 > 16000) indicates expanding economic activity that supports corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 16000.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5%, it signals economic weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5.

mechanism_narrative: High residential sales (RSAFS > 400000) combined with low Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) indicates strong housing demand and accommodative monetary policy, fueling economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when RSAFS > 400000 and FEDFUNDS < 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regimes (INDPRO < 100), low Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) signals aggressive monetary stimulus to counteract supply contraction, generating positive S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate economic recovery.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and FEDFUNDS < 0.25%.
